'''First Anthology Sealed''' is a limited format that uses the contents of a [[First Anthology]] box as the card pool. Decipher published First Anthology in May 1997. Each box held two Premiere Unlimited starter decks, two [[A New Hope Limited]] packs, and two [[Hoth Limited]] packs. It held one [[Jedi Pack]], six white-border [[Special Edition]] preview cards, and a rules supplement covering A New Hope through Dagobah.

== Organized play ==
* [[1997 Decipher World Championship First Anthology Sealed]] at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Forty World Finals invitees each received a First Anthology set signed by Decipher's product development team.<ref name="dec-sealed">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Report 10], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19980223172645/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sealedsummary.html Internet Archive]</ref>
